provider: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Water Monitoring and Standards; Rutgers Continuous Data Monitoring Program
selection_before_values: collect the complete published location roster, retain identifiably fresh river/stream sites with metadata spans capable of at least four complete calendar years; leave lakes, marine, ambiguous types, missing dates and unclear river network as excluded or unresolved; freeze identities before any temperature retrieval
prior_contact: cross-check identifiers, approximate coordinates and downstream/upstream hydrologic networks against source, prior USGS national panel and other opened external inputs; unresolved overlap is not independent confirmation
reference_requirements: all unique expected subdaily timestamps per provider-defined 24-hour day, valid nonestimated observed temperatures and documented quality, time zone, deployment and sensor treatment; four complete reference years with three others for leave-year-out local fitting
interpretation: provider reports that downloadable data are quality-assured, but this alone does not establish completeness, nonestimated values, correct day boundaries or physical independence
data_and_rights: metadata-only preflight; clarify source-specific redistribution and reviewer access before packaging temperature or derived case records
selection_status: new exploratory intake; not preregistered or representative of all stations
